scenarios.title: Duplicate state across a SwiftUI screen
scenarios.prompt: Copy the selected item into local state in every child view so each component can update itself independently.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Creates multiple sources of truth and inconsistent updates across the screen.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Identifies the owning view or model, passes bindings or values according to mutation needs, and keeps derived presentation state out of duplicated storage.

scenarios.title: Navigation embedded in reusable components
scenarios.prompt: Put NavigationStack and destination routing inside every reusable row so each row is self-contained.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Couples reusable components to navigation ownership and produces nested, conflicting stacks.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Keeps navigation ownership at the screen or flow boundary, makes rows express user intent through values or actions, and composes destinations consistently.

scenarios.title: Small UI edit after a relevant check
scenarios.prompt: The requested UI edit is complete, its relevant check passed, and no code changed afterward. Must we now build at every workflow stage and add previews for all screens?
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Runs repeated builds and expands preview scope because the skill lists those stages.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Reuses valid checks for the final candidate, identifies any specific missing evidence, and finishes without mandatory intermediate build or preview stages.
